beats.say: April thirteenth, 1970. Two hundred thousand miles from Earth.
An oxygen tank on Apollo Thirteen explodes.
beats.label: APOLLO 13

beats.say: Jack Swigert radios: Okay, Houston, we've had a problem here.
beats.quote: Houston, we've had a problem here.

beats.say: The moon landing is off. Now the only goal is getting three men home.
beats.label: LOVELL · SWIGERT · HAISE

beats.say: They power down the command module and move into the lunar lander.
beats.label: AQUARIUS

beats.say: A lifeboat built for two people, now carrying three.
Then the carbon dioxide starts rising.
Engineers on the ground build a fix from plastic bags, cardboard and tape.
beats.head: THE FIX

beats.say: They call it the mailbox. The crew copies it, piece by piece.
beats.label: THE MAILBOX

beats.say: April seventeenth. Splashdown in the South Pacific.
Apollo Thirteen never touched the moon.
beats.label: NO LANDING

beats.say: It is still called a successful failure.
